title: Which Animal Has Three Hearts?
description:
Two hearts serve the gills, and one serves the rest of the body.

The octopus and other cephalopods have three hearts.

Two branchial hearts send oxygen-poor blood through the gills; the systemic heart pumps oxygenated blood to the body.

Their blood is blue because the oxygen carrier hemocyanin contains copper.
